about.intro: RayCarWash brings professional car care directly to your doorstep. We're transforming how people think about car maintenance — no more waiting in line at a wash bay or rearranging your schedule for a detailing appointment.
storyBody: We started RayCarWash because we experienced the same frustration as everyone else: car care always seemed to require too much time and too many compromises. Whether it was finding someone to watch the kids while you waited at a wash, or blocking out half a day for a detail, traditional car care simply didn't fit modern life.

Our solution was simple: bring the detailer to the car. By connecting clients with vetted, independent detailers who bring everything needed to the client's location, we've eliminated the friction from car care — making it as easy as ordering a ride.

items.q: How much does a typical wash cost?
items.a: Exterior washes start at $49, interior details at $89, full details at $149. Final price depends on vehicle size, condition, and any add-ons. You always see a flat quote before you book.

items.q: Do I need to be home during the service?
items.a: Nope. Plenty of customers leave the keys or have us work while they're at the office. We'll send photos and a notification when it's done.

items.q: How long does a detail take?
items.a: Exterior wash: 45–60 minutes. Interior detail: 1.5–2 hours. Full detail: 3–4 hours. Add-ons extend by 20–40 minutes each.

items.q: Do detailers bring water and power?
items.a: Yes. Every detailer arrives self-contained with water tanks, generators, and pro-grade products.

items.q: What happens if it rains?
items.a: We'll reach out before the appointment to either reschedule for free or proceed if you're OK with that. Indoor parking? Service goes ahead as planned.

items.q: Can I tip in the app?
items.a: Yes. After the job, you can add a tip in any amount. 100% goes to the detailer.

items.q: How do recurring bookings work?
items.a: After your first detail, you can save the detailer and book recurring weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly cleans with one tap.

items.q: Is my data and payment info safe?
items.a: Yes. Payments are processed by a PCI-compliant payment provider. We never store your card number. Your address is shared with the detailer only after they accept the job.

items.q: How much does it really cost to join?
items.a: Nothing up front. We deduct a platform fee from each completed job — that covers payment processing, insurance coverage during service, dispatch, support, and marketing. You keep the rest, including 100% of tips.

items.q: Do I need to be a full-time detailer?
items.a: No. A portion of our detailers work part-time or weekends only. Set your hours and we'll route jobs to fit.

items.q: Can I bring my existing clients?
items.a: Yes. We have a referral code system — anyone you refer who books through the app gets a discount and you get a bonus on top of your usual cut.

items.q: What about insurance?
items.a: We carry commercial general liability that covers damage caused by you during a service. Your personal auto policy still covers transit. We recommend you also carry your own business liability.

items.q: How fast do I actually get paid?
items.a: Funds initiate transfer after the job is marked complete. Most banks post within a few business days; faster options may be available.

items.q: Can I decline jobs?
items.a: Always. Decline rate doesn't affect your standing as long as you don't ghost. The app shows you the full job details before you accept.

items.q: What happens if a customer disputes the work?
items.a: We use the before/after photos you captured, the timeline of the job, and the customer's complaint. Most disputes are resolved with a re-service rather than a refund.

items.q: Will mechanic prices be different from the detailing side?

items.q: What if my car needs work I can't get done in a driveway?
